summary: An independent Fulham agency covering sales, lettings and management is a strength, but two addresses and a missing contact route appear to cost you landlord and tenant enquiries.

findings.problem: The contact block appears to list Riverbank House 1 Putney Bridge Approach while the legal line gives 7 Fulham Road SW6 4JU, and the phone appears as 0203 617 1994 and 020 3617 1994.
findings.cost: A landlord or tenant cannot tell which office is real or where to go.
findings.fix: One verified address and one phone format.

findings.problem: The email address appears only as an obfuscated placeholder, and no general contact form appears, only offer and viewing forms.
findings.cost: A landlord who wants a valuation has no easy way to write to you.
findings.fix: A valuation and general enquiry form that sends straight to your team.

findings.problem: The main Buying link appears to use the lettings department, and the Tenants link appears in two versions (/tenants/ and /tenants-2/).
findings.cost: Buyers and tenants land on the wrong pages and leave.
findings.fix: Correct links and one page per audience.

findings.problem: The tenancy length dropdown appears to show only the run on text 010203040506070809101112, a stray character follows each form, and the CMP certificate file name appears misspelled.
findings.cost: Broken form details and typos reduce confidence before a landlord shares property information.
findings.fix: Clean labeled forms and proofread files.

redesign: Clean forms, correct links and proofread files.
